skill.summary: Get current weather and forecasts (no API key required). And also 50+ models for image generation, video generation, text-to-speech, speech-to-text, music, c...

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of weather-hub skill.

- Provides current weather and forecasts with no API key required
- Adds access to 50+ models (image/video generation, TTS, STT, music, chat, web search, document parsing, email, SMS)
- Supports unified API key across providers (Bedrock, OpenAI, Vertex, ElevenLabs, Replicate, Minimax, etc.)
- Includes smart routing for auto-selecting optimal models
- Example Bash commands and usage details provided in documentation
